prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Konaki-jiji, the uncanny OLD MAN who cries like a baby and becomes impossibly heavy when picked up on a mountain road. Entirely original design, no manga or anime character.
ANATOMY: ONE obviously ELDERLY ADULT MAN with deeply wrinkled face, bald crown, sparse grey hair, two eyes squeezed almost shut and wide CRYING MOUTH. He wears oversized opaque simple BABY-STYLE CLOTHES with large tied bib beneath a coarse STRAW RAINCOAT, holds ONE plain WALKING STICK tucked alongside body. Two arms/two legs, no actual infant, no child [konaki-jiji-c02,konaki-jiji-c10].
MOMENT: The old spirit clings tightly to ONE fully clothed ADULT traveler who has picked him up; traveler sinks to one bent knee under impossible weight, boots dig deeply into muddy road and cloak compresses beneath the burden. Old man's elderly crying face dominates foreground, his two arms grip traveler's shoulders, his two legs hang clearly in baby-style trousers. Adult traveler remains unharmed and face secondary, no crushing or injury.
POWER: becomes impossibly heavy and clings once held; show physical body strain, muddy boot depressions and pulled cloth, NO stone transformation, beams or aura [konaki-jiji-c03,konaki-jiji-c11].
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low close angle, crying OLD MAN spirit and straw raincoat fill upper square, adult carrier partly behind, no giant size or actual baby.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one low warm moonbeam through trees rims wrinkled face and straw, deep walnut mountain shadows, ordinary drizzle and mud droplets.
SURFACE: deeply aged wrinkled skin, coarse wet straw raincoat, opaque plain baby-style wool cloth, muddy leather boots.
SETTING: Tokushima mountain night road, trees secondary [konaki-jiji-c01].
MOOD: intensely uncanny impossible burden and confrontation, never cute baby, comic gag, calm grandfather or decorative pose. No blood, injury or gore.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, inscriptions, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or fingers; no design borrowed from any film, game, anime or comic; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline or energy ribbons. Premium painterly brushwork, dark warm walnut and antique gold palette, square composition.
